friction: validate_plan first failed: metadata.version is required (not documented in omd://reference).

Top-level operating_points (ac|propulsion|engine|rating, ac|propulsion|propeller|diameter, ac|weights|structural_fudge) passed validation but were silently ignored: the recorded engine rating stayed 750 hp and the prop diameter 2.28 m.

config.aircraft_data together with aircraft_template passed validation but was silently ignored (MTOW, engine rating and structural factor were all unchanged); aircraft_data without a template replaces the whole aircraft and fails setup with connection/ambiguity errors.
initial_values did not take effect in an analysis-only plan with no design variables; they applied once the plan had design variables and an objective.

The structural weight factor is not exposed as ac|weights|structural_fudge; had to find the per-phase path analysis.<phase>.acmodel.OEW.const.structural_fudge by probing get_results, and set it for all 8 phases in initial_values.
run_plan 'overrides' is a plan-level patch, not a variable-value map; passing variable names gave a USER_INPUT_ERROR (additional properties not allowed).
plan_add_dv accepted a nonexistent DV name ('bogus') without error, despite its description saying names are validated.
get_results(summary=true) returned ~310k characters, too large to read; had to query variables by name, and unknown names are silently dropped instead of reported.
run_plan inlines full mission profiles in every response, which makes responses very long.
The run with recording_level=minimal triggered a spurious '1 driver iteration' convergence warning because only the final case is recorded.
The cost-model parameters (fuel price, electricity price, OEM premium, depreciation, battery cost) could not be inspected through the tools; I assumed include_cost_model uses the paper's values.
The reported margins.MTOW_margin (20.3 kg) does not match MTOW - OEW - fuel - battery - payload computed from the summary OEW (~9 kg); the per-phase OEW values may differ. Not resolved.
